title: My Old House Key Went WARM 🔑
premise: In our town a key goes warm when someone is waiting for you behind its door, and my key to the blue house on the hill we sold nine years ago went warm.
twist: My big sister Jess bought the house back and had been inside since Monday waiting for me to notice, and she never changed the lock.
world: A sunny hill street of small painted houses, an old blue house with a white porch and a warm front hall, and my bright apartment entry with a row of key hooks.
